item.title: University leadership emphasizes academic freedom at Family Weekend panel

item.title: University to pursue investigation, increase security following antisemitic emails
item.description: The University issued a statement condemning antisemitism Monday morning following threatening emails to Jewish community members. The post University to pursue investigation, increase security following antisemitic emails appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Defending Eileen Gu

item.title: What is There Not to Love: The insufferable, helpless Juliette in ‘Shatter Me’

The post What is There Not to Love: The insufferable, helpless Juliette in ‘Shatter Me’ appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
